issues.description: Method addGuestStudents parameter mismatch: the template declares addGuestStudents as public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents, boolean validateInput) (template src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java line 19), but the problem statement's task description and UML specify a single-parameter method addGuestStudents(int) (problem_statement.md line 50 and UML at line 73). The solution implements public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents) (solution src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java line 90). The extra boolean parameter in the template creates an API mismatch that will confuse students and prevent their implementations from matching the expected single-parameter signature used in the specification and reference solution.
